# Plane project configuration

Template for `.claude/plane-workflow.md` in a project root. Initialization fills
this in from live Plane data — see [initialization.md](initialization.md). Do not
hand-write the IDs; they must come from the API or they will be wrong.

Copy everything below the line.

---

## State roles

Every state the lifecycle refers to, bound to this project's real states. Roles
with no matching state are recorded as `none` — the lifecycle skips them.

| Role | State name | `state_id` | Group |
| ---- | ---------- | ---------- | ----- |
| `start` — set when work begins | | | |
| `review` — set at hand-off, the agent's last state change | | | |
| `plan` — where parent/feature items are created | | | |
